data.caption:
T20 debut mein naye bowler ne sabko hairaan kar diya!

🏏 Jamshad Alam ne ki aisi bowling
🔥 T20 debut match mein liya kamaal
⚡ 4 gendon par jhatke 4 wicket

Aise debut ke baad batsman toh seedha pavillion hi bhagenge.

Comment mein batao: kya aapne kabhi gully cricket mein continuous wickets liye hain?
